De Lille vs DA

By: Liz Fish | Production

Proposal


Show:

Summary:
After 5 months of trying to get disciplinary process against Patricia De Lille underway and De Lille insisting the DA FEDEXEC were biased and she wanted the process adjudicated by a retired judge and in the public they finally got rid of the entire process by withdrawing her membership because of an interview with 702 where she said she would walk away from the DA once her case was fought. The DA used the 3.5.1.2 clause to pull the plug on the whole saga. She is now contesting this in court on Friday. But nothing is resolved.
If De Lille is no longer a member of the DA how does she clear her name? All everybody wants to know is a conclusion to these charges- in an extended interview we hear her side of the story?
The charges in questions are
• De Lille allegedly exerted undue influence on members of a selection panel tasked with appointing the Cape Town city manager, by sending a text message to the panel reading: “I want to keep [erstwhile city manager Achmat Ebrahim] so score him the highest. Thanks.”
• De Lille allegedly blocked an investigation into potential corruption involving the City’s transport authority.
• De Lille allegedly contravened the Finance Management Act by failing to report financial irregularities relating to the MyCiTi bus project to the Cape Town City Council.
• She similarly allegedly failed to report irregularities relating to the Foreshore housing project.
• De Lille allegedly behaved in an “intimidating and belittling” manner to City Council caucus members who challenged her.
• She was also accused of attempting to solicit a R5-million bribe from businessman Anthony Faul in 2013, a charge taken seriously enough by the DA’s federal executive that they went public with the claim and laid a criminal complaint against her.

The FedExec said all these charges would be made public- we will hold them to their commitment and get them to outline the charges and what their investigation of the last 5 months have revealed.

Press Release:


e Lille vs The DA
The battle between the Democratic Alliance and Cape Town mayor, Patricia de Lille has finally come to a head. After months of attempting to remove De Lille from office through internal party disciplinary processes, the DA finally succeeded by withdrawing her membership. As the party continues to defend its position, De Lille insists she’s not going without a fight and some analysts believe that these recent events show that the DA is imploding and losing support in its key constituencies. Carte Blanche analyses a party in crisis.


Script:


Script: It’s been a torrid week for the DA, Patricia De Lille and the citizens of Cape Town. Their mayor was summarily removed from office after having her membership revoked by the DA’s Federal Executive.
Link: The Patricia De Lille saga which has been raging on for 8 months now and it has divided the city and Capetonians and they are outside court both for and against her
Vox Denzil Klaase “We support that she can stay as mayor ”
Vox Pops Kashiefa Reagon” We don’t want de Lille as our mayor “
Link: What has astound everyone was that her membership could be withdrawn based on a complaint about what she had said in a radio interview with Show host Eusebius Mac Keiser from Cape Talk 702
De Lille “They claim that I had announced my intention to resign. Eusebius and myself with talking about being the major because my fight with the DA it is always been about them wanting me out as Mayor.. It is never been about termination of membership. In 2015 Mmusi Maimaine the leader of the DA said that he will resign if the DA doesn't deliver services. That clause it cease your membership right there. Yet again comes the double standards when it comes to Patricia De Lille
Script: De Lille believes the DA took the short cut to get rid of her. We asked Natasha Mazzone the Deputy Chair of the DA Federal Executive if the investigation was failing, and this was a convenient out.
Natasha: I have a simple answer to that. How were any of us to know that Patricia De Lille would go on the Eusebius Show and announce her intention to resign? So that argument is completely flawed. I think what happened is that Patricia told the truth and after she told the truth she realized that she'd actually contravened a very important section of the DA Constitution.
Script: Once the announcement was made, the City of Cape Town immediately removed her from Office, and Deputy Mayor Ian Nielson fills the position until new mayor can be elected.
But for most Capetonians, the process has been so confusing and they have no idea what she is guilty of
Link: Now that De Lille has had her membership withdrawn the DA Federal Executive have made gone public all 39 charges against De Lille and on face value some of them are extremely serious from bribery to interfering in the appointment of the former City manager.
Natasha “ There were charges of gross mismanagement attempts to hide corruption. Loyalty to certain members that shouldn't have been there. The obfuscation of responsibility in terms of reports that should have come to council and also a lack of leadership and cohesion within the caucus that created an untenable environment in which council has had to operate
Script: But the process has been confusing, because the charges in the Steenhuizen report have been mixed in with the City of Cape Town forensic investigation, known as the Bowman Gilfillan report
De Lille [08:34:12] first one is that there was the Steenhuisen report. It contained a number of allegations with no names no surnames no incidents and out of Steenhuisen report they then took two of those allegations and made them charges against me. But in putting out the whole Steenhuisen report to the public. People did not understand that these things were not tested because it was like a quasi-disciplinary hearing this sort of be guilty on those untested things.
Script: De Lille went to court demanding the full access to how the Steenhuisen report arrived at its charges
Natasha And the reason the Steenhuisen report wasn’t revealed to the public was because there was fear of retribution amongst council officials and counsellors who had given evidence for lack of a better word they were whistle blowers and we have an obligation to protect whistle blowers
Script: De Lille has maintained that accurate information about the allegations was withheld
Natasha When you're charged you get presented just almost like a court of law with a summons and a D.A. FLC charge sheet and you get given a copy of the FLC rules. The charge sheet is massive
De Lille: They are absolutely lying. I had to go to court to court them I've got the court papers in the case numbers that can send you to say to the court that I want to set aside and review the Steenhuisen report. The court ordered to give us the information.
Script: The DA says they’ve been upholding their constitution and De Lille’s rights to privacy, and so denied the Media access to her disciplinary process.
De Lille “I am the accused I wanted open because they didn't think about my privacy when they put all of those allegations out to the public. My name is being smeared in public and I want to clear my name in public
Link “Now that Patricia has had her membership terminated the parties charges are no longer applicable, however the more serious charges which are contained in the Bowman Gilfillian report pertaining to the City of Cape Town still remain
Script: These allegations relate to financial irregularities in the Myciti bus project, and failing to report irregularities in the Foreshore Freeway project, amongst others
Natasha “Patricia De Lille is no longer a member of the D.A. but she is still accountable for what actions or non-actions took place when she was the mayor of Cape Town. And those investigations are ongoing.
Script: The acrimony runs deep. This week the screen grab of the message De Lille allegedly sent to sway the election of the City Manger” I want to keep Achmat so score him highest” was made available publically.
Natasha “This is a copy of the SMS. It's a screen grab that was taken off the phone
Mac “And this was part of the evidence
Natasha” Yes
Mac “They showed me a copy of the screengrab regarding the sms that this happened can you maybe clear this for us
De Lille We've been struggling more than three months to get the evidence. Even at the last hearing they were not able to produce. It shows you once again how far they are prepared to go to smear my name
Script: And the bribe allegation, comes from a potential supplier who says he lost the deal because she wanted R5 millon to ensure he won the tender
De Lille [09:02:19] This guy, Mr Faul sitting on information for more than six year that he claims he didn’t go to the police immediately he goes to the DA. They didn’t even check out who is this Mr Faul This Mr Faud has been struck off the roles of attorneys for a couple of years already. You can’t just believe allegations.I'm going to sue the hell out of all of them that have smeared my name like this
Script: When we attempted to go through the list of charges Ms De Lille lost her cool
De Lille ; I've have now answered enough to this nonsense you should have asked them did you give Patricia De Lille a fair hearing to test these allegations. I don’t need to answer to you I need to answer to them and due process
UP Sound Not that I am above the law the party is not above the law
You have chased away the black voters
Script: The consequences for the DA are going to be felt for a long time says analyst Sanusha Naidu
Sanusha ”There's been speculation that this may actually create some kind of negative trend for the DA particularly in terms of its footprint amongst the coloured voter etc. …but the real challenge I think for the whole for the D.A. is the confidence issue and the trust issue. So does Patricia De lille have a major footprint amongst the coloured community. She is a stalwart. Yes she does. But does that translate into the culture community voting as a homogenous bloc. I don't think so
Natasha The Patricia De Lille issue has caused us massive reputational damage but we were willing to risk our reputation to make sure that the public knew that we would always hold our own executive to account.
UPsound ANC Presser” I think we have all been witness to the events that have taken place over the last 24 hours to an unconstitutional attempt to capture the City of Cape Town
Script: The ANC joined the fray declaring the City had been captured, and that De Lille remain in her position.
Upsound ANC “ Patricia De Lille is the mayor of Cape Town and she remains so until the IEC declares otherwise
Sanusha “ It is almost poetic justice in a sense for some political parties particularly the ANC because they're going to say well yeah you've been always you know challenging us and telling us about the bad governance that we had
Script: Many are asking where things started to go wrong, and both sides have very different answers
De Lille “ They have got their own agenda. Politics is about power. So they have now made those power deals and I am in the way I need to get out
Natsha [07:58:12] I think it started going wrong at a time that that mayor De Lille felt that she was going to make unilateral decisions and didn't feel happy with people challenging her on those decisions.
Macfarlane “ What do you make of the motions of no confidence that a failed against you
De Lille “I have been elected by 66 percent of the people of this city, you are there because people have voted you in to go and represent them. And now my fate must be decided by a few councillors just in the DA caucus not even the whole full council that consist of many other political parties.
Sanusha [07:19:50] She's very astute politically she's very very clever. She has used it to vilify the DA and on the other hand the DA look she is milking it for political mileage and expediency. Both sides are playing this to the hilt.
Script: And her future remains unclear, judgement was reserved on the reinstatement of her membership, the MAYCO committee remains in place, and the IEC cannot put a new mayor in until judgement is reached.
